landing.guideHint: Simple steps for the family and friends who help with the plans.
landing.step1Text: The family admin makes an account for you. You will be given an email and a password.
landing.step2Text: Tap the Log in button at the top of this page and type them in.
landing.step3Text: Budget shows the costs. Guests is where you add the people we invite. Vendors lists the hotels and other services.
landing.step4Text: Switch between සිංහල and English at the top at any time. Every list can be downloaded as an Excel sheet.
